item: Row 445: an unread non-UTF-8 name renders as JSON on every platform
summary: Test-only. The filesystem test of R778's non-UTF-8 name skips where the file system refuses such a name (APFS, EILSEQ; lane I's fix on #2404). This adds a test that runs everywhere: the walk hands back a surrogate-escaped name standing in for a real file, its open is refused, and the restore result must still encode as UTF-8 JSON with the byte replaced. Mutation-checked: with the replacement removed both tests fail.
